title: zazz-worker component diagram
description: The zazz-worker crate and what crosses its boundary: zazzled's zazz module starts it and talks to it; it runs scripts on wasmtime with WASI preview 1, shares frames, messages and the HTTP layout with zazz-sdk, and sends allowed HTTPS requests for scripts. Its modules are in the src/ diagram.

components.name: zazz-worker crate
components.responsibility: Builds the zazz-worker binary: a workspace member with its own rust-version, because wasmtime follows recent Rust releases.

components.name: zazz-worker source
components.responsibility: The subcommands, the engine, per-call instances with the zazz_host imports, serve mode, test mode and the network backends.

components.name: zazz-sdk (lib zazz)
components.responsibility: Frames and messages (proto), descriptor passing (fdpass), JSON, errors and the HTTP request, response and host allowlist (http), shared with the scripts.

components.name: zazzled zazz module
components.responsibility: Finds zazz-worker beside zazzled (or $ZAZZ_WORKER), runs compile and test for builds, and keeps serve workers warm for calls.

components.name: wasmtime and wasmtime-wasi
components.responsibility: The WebAssembly runtime (Cranelift AOT compilation, epoch interruption, store limits) and WASI preview 1 (stdio, preopened directories, clocks, random).

components.name: HTTPS servers
components.responsibility: Hosts a script is allowed to reach, through ureq with bundled roots and no redirects.

relationships.description: Runs `zazz-worker compile` (WASM on stdin, module on stdout) and `zazz-worker test`, and spawns `zazz-worker serve` with the control socket on fd 3 and the module on fd 4.
Path dependency: proto, fdpass, Json, Error and http (NetPolicy, Request, Response, check).
Compiles, loads and instantiates modules; links WASI preview 1.
Sends a script's allowed requests in serve mode; test mode answers from a replay file instead.
